planets.name: HATS-75 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HATS-75 with a 2.79-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: HATS-75 b was found in 2021 by HATSouth as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HATS-75. Its orbit and size follow Jordán et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
